PGA Championship Betting: Odds to Win Golf's Second Major

Explore the latest PGA Championship odds and betting markets at FanDuel Sportsbook. As one of professional golf's four men's major championships, the PGA Championship draws the strongest field in the sport, all vying for the prestigious Wanamaker Trophy. Played annually in May, typically the weekend before Memorial Day, it's the second major of the golf season, following the Masters, making it a pivotal event for players and bettors alike. FanDuel provides comprehensive golf odds for every aspect of this storied tournament, from outright winners to specific player props.



Who Has the Best Odds to Win the 2026 PGA Championship?

For the upcoming 2026 PGA Championship, set to take place at Aronimink Golf Club in Newtown Square, Pennsylvania, Scottie Scheffler currently leads the field as the favorite with impressive +340 odds to win. Close behind are golf titans like Rory McIlroy at +750 and Jon Rahm at +1400. These pga odds this week and throughout the lead-up to the tournament are constantly updated by FanDuel’s expert oddsmakers, reflecting player form, course fit, and betting action. Keep an eye on the FanDuel Sportsbook app and website for real-time adjustments and the most competitive pga betting odds.
